title: One dead and scores rescued in floods in Spain | CNN
text:
Source: Reuters

A woman aged 102 died and firefighters rescued 90 people after flooding in the town of Madrigueras in southeastern Spain, regional authorities said on Saturday.

The flooding follows thehottest summer on recordin Spain, where almost 2,150 people are thought to have died from heat-related causes in August.

Cars were floating in the streets of Madrigueras after heavy rain on Friday and prompted a large-scale rescue operation, said authorities in the Castilla-La Mancha region.

Firefighters found the body of the woman who died in her house in Madrigueras where the water had risen to over 1 meter (3 feet).

Authorities said 142 litres of rainfall per square meter fell on the town of 4,760 inhabitants.

Heavy rains fell in many areas of southeastern and northeastern Spain on Friday.
